notes.title: World of Final Fantasy is out now on Steam!
notes.content:
Today is the day you can venture into Grymoire on your PC as World of Final Fantasy is out now on Steam!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31073435/b19796f6f5c596dc4c1111f7844ff39b5eb7a677.jpg[/img]
In World of Final Fantasy, you will lead a pair of twins, Reynn and Lann through the land of Grymoire on a search to rediscover their lost memories. Along the way, they’ll come across many familiar faces from the Final Fantasy franchise in an incredible (and adorable) adventure! 
https://youtu.be/52m0v2BscOQ
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31073435/2b3974bf65f2047e6cf55af76841a42feee18c1c.jpg[/img]
If you’re an old school Final Fantasy fan, you’ll love the unique story, seeing all the legendary heroes together in a new (OMG they’re so cute) way and experiencing a new strategic take on the Active Time Battle system that features stacking characters and monsters.
Throughout Reynn and Lann’s adventure, you will collect, raise and battle adorable beings of classic Final Fantasy lore including the lovable chocobo, cactuar and behemoth to create customisable, strategic tower combinations to take on the most challenging foes.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31073435/c5a369933f1268228e7688a869dea3f92e406966.jpg[/img]
Don’t forget that for one week only (until 28th November 2017), you can also get the Day One Edition which comes with two mesmerising bonuses:
1.) A digital soundtrack sampler featuring enchanting tracks from the game.
2.) A beautiful wallpaper (as shown below) that is stacked to the brim with Final Fantasy heroes and creatures.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31073435/2645fbdc2a276f2f26c2e9b60f092bb09a507ac0.jpg[/img]
It will be available in the following sizes:
1024 x 768
1280 x 1024
1920 x 1080
2560 x 1600
And on top of all this, the game also comes with a host of legendary creatures and summons including Sephiroth, Balthier, Boko and many more!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31073435/849641c94c39876689915f44dec8991204ba58a8.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31073435/071b8f69eaa8b6056f53593f8e37c25d93dbe150.jpg[/img]
As a reminder here’s the minimum and recommended specs to run World of Final Fantasy on PC:
[u]OS supported[/u]
Windows 7 64bit
Windows 8/8.1 64 bit
Windows 10 64 bit
[u]Required specs[/u]
OS: Windows 7 64bit
CPU: Intel Core i3 2.0GHz or above
Ram: 4GB or greater
HDD/SDD: 15GB or greater
Graphics card: NVIDIA GeForce GTS 450 1GB or higher
Radeon HD 5770 1GB or higher
Sound Card: sound device that supports DirectX 11 
DirectX: 11
[u]Recommended specs[/u]
OS: Windows 8/8.1 64 bit or Windows 10 64 bit
CPU: Intel Core i3 2.4GHz or above
Ram: 8GB or greater
HDD/SDD: 15GB or greater
Graphics card: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 2GB or higher
Radeon HD 7850 2GB or higher
Sound Card: sound device that supports DirectX 11 
DirectX: 11
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31073435/8ee8872eda80748001dde156413913a1acda531d.jpg[/img]
If you’re new to the Final Fantasy franchise then World of Final Fantasy is a perfect introduction to the series and its characters. You can jump into the game without any prior knowledge or experience with the rest of the franchise. So whether you’ve played all the Final Fantasy games or only a couple, World of Final Fantasy is perfect for all generations of Final Fantasy fans.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31073435/1757a5892221c3b468941432c38ee94917399ffe.jpg[/img]

notes.title: World of Final Fantasy is coming to Steam!
notes.content:
Time to pile on your excitement as World of Final Fantasy is coming to Steam on 21st November 2017!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31073435/c5a369933f1268228e7688a869dea3f92e406966.jpg[/img]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=52m0v2BscOQ&t=12s
In World of Final Fantasy, you will embark on a magical journey with siblings Reynn and Lann as they explore the vast land of Grymoire to rediscover their past and save the future.
There’s an all new battle system involving customising and evolving captured monsters to create powerful erected towers of monsters to fight foes. With the right strategies and monster combinations, you can really stack the odds in your favour.
There will be a special Day One Edition available for the first week of release over on our [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/552700/WORLD_OF_FINAL_FANTASY/]Steam page here[/url] which comes with two mesmerising bonuses:

1.) A digital soundtrack sampler featuring enchanting tracks from the game.
2.) A beautiful wallpaper (as shown below) that is stacked to the brim with Final Fantasy heroes and creatures.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31073435/9962093224812a49e6c512f470027a2794dd10f8.jpg[/img]

1024 x 768
